use Style = {?fg: ?Array[Int], ?bold: ?Bool}

fn style-for(name: String) -> Style | nil {
    match name {
        'red'  => ({fg: [31]}),
        'bold' => ({bold: true}),
        _      => nil
    }
}

fn style-or-plain(name: String) -> Style {
    if name == 'bold' {
        ({bold: true})
    } else {
        ({fg: [0]})
    }
}

fn iround(x: Float) -> Int { int(x) }

fn make-gradient(grad: (Float) -> (Int, Int, Int)) -> (Float) -> String {
    t -> "{grad(t)}"
}

fn rgb-gradient(c1: (Int, Int, Int), c2: (Int, Int, Int)) -> (Float) -> String {
    let (r1, g1, b1) = c1
    let (r2, g2, b2) = c2
    make-gradient(
        t -> (
            iround(r1 + (r2 - r1) * t),
            iround(g1 + (g2 - g1) * t),
            iround(b1 + (b2 - b1) * t)
        )
    )
}

class Longer {
    __n: Int
    init(n: Int) { __n = n }
    __call__(s: String) -> Bool { #s > __n }
}

fn keep-long(words: Array[String]) -> Array[String] {
    words.filter(Longer(1))
}

fn drop-blank(lines: Array[String]) -> Array[String] {
    lines.dropWhile!(/^\s*$/)
}

fn tails(words: Array[String]) -> Array[String] {
    words.map(&[1;])
}

fn unescape(part: String) -> String {
    part.sub(/\\./, &[1;])
}

fn count-kinds(parts: Array[String | RegexMatch]) -> Int {
    let n = 0
    for match parts {
        part: String => { n += 1 },
        RegexMatch({captures}) => { n += #captures }
    }
    n
}

fn tally(words: Array[String]) -> Dict[String, Int] {
    let counts = %{*: 0}
    for w in words {
        counts[w] += 1
    }
    counts
}

fn describe(c) -> String {
    let (name, _, members) = doc(c)
    "{name} with {#members} members"
}

let fds = %{nil: 2, *: #it}
let key: String | nil = 'abc'
let fd: Int = fds[key] ?? 0

print(
    style-for('red'),
    style-or-plain('bold'),
    rgb-gradient((0, 0, 0), (255, 255, 255))(0.5),
    keep-long(['a', 'bb']),
    drop-blank(['', 'x']),
    tails(['ab', 'c']),
    unescape('a\\.b'),
    count-kinds(['x', 'y']),
    tally(['a', 'b', 'a']),
    describe(Int),
    fd,
    fds[nil]
)
